provider.name: Asheville Parks & Recreation (City of Asheville summer camps)
provider.hint: Registration runs through the city's WebTrac site (ncashevilleweb.myvscloud.com); a separate deterministic parser reads that catalog.

extraction.notes: 2027 camp schedules and registration information are not yet posted. The official camp page says they will be published February 1, 2027; this is an information-publication date, not a registration opening date. All extracted camp facts describe 2026. The city page says no camp June 19, although WebTrac lists June 15-19 for traditional camps. Outdoor camp prices differ: the city page lists $120/$220/$180 without residency tiers, while WebTrac lists resident/nonresident prices of $110/$120, $210/$220, and $170/$180 respectively; the registration-platform tiers are recorded below. WebTrac age limits for traditional camps are recorded alongside the city page's rising-grade eligibility without converting either. Traditional weekly sessions are left for the separate catalog parser. 'Unavailable' catalog statuses were not interpreted as closed or full. No registration opening date for 2027 was found.
